name: Pricing & Promotions core scenarios
description: Real Pricing & Promotions Q&A pairs grounded in the synthetic seed data (see data/generate_seed_data.py): a markdown cadence/depth question (Sandal), a strong promo-lift question (Rain Jacket), a weak/negative promo-lift question (Ankle Boot), and a cross-promo ranking question. NOT currently wired to a runnable eval CLI gate: `adk eval` (google-adk 2.5.0) doesn't support YAML Agent Config agents (confirmed 2026-07-26 against ADK source, see architecture spec section 8) -- these cases are content-ready but need either a different eval mechanism or an ADK fix before they run as a quality gate.

parts.text: What has the markdown cadence and depth looked like for the Sandal?

The Sandal has gone through three markdowns roughly three weeks apart, each one deeper than the last, dropping from its regular $35 price down to $28, then $21, then $14, based on internal pricing data.
How effective was the Rainy Season Kickoff promotion for the Rain Jacket?
The Rainy Season Kickoff promotion was highly effective for the Rain Jacket, with daily units sold roughly tripling versus baseline during the promo period, based on internal promo lift data.
Did the Boot Clearance Push promotion actually increase sales of the Ankle Boot?

No, based on internal promo lift data the Boot Clearance Push promotion did not meaningfully move Ankle Boot sales -- daily units during the promo were roughly flat to slightly below the pre-promo baseline.
Which of our recent promotions delivered the strongest sales lift?

The Rainy Season Kickoff promotion on the Rain Jacket delivered by far the strongest lift among recent promotions, based on internal promo lift data, well ahead of the Footwear Category Days and Outerwear Flash Sale promotions.
